entries.zh: 排解处置（纠纷、事务）；居中调解
entries.en: to mediate and settle (a matter or dispute); to interpose as a third party

entries.zh: 居间说和、做和事佬；充当调停人
entries.en: to mediate between parties; to act as peacemaker or middleman

entries.zh: 做中人；充当买卖居间中保
entries.en: to act as middleman or go-between; to broker between buyer and seller

entries.zh: 出言尖酸刻薄、嘴利骂人；尖嘴
entries.en: to speak sharply or abusively; sharp-mouthed

entries.zh: 出言伤人、口舌尖利；尖舌
与人纠缠吵闹；缠磨、刁难人
entries.en: to wrangle with people; to pester others
entries.notes: 「蟠」字面为盘曲，此处取纠缠缠磨之引申义，词义据本页 terciar mal 词族与闽音 poan-lang 推断。

entries.zh: 出言顶撞、嘴上不让人；尖口

entries.notes: 西语头词 Fercio pelv 系 terciopelo 之缩讹，绒料义据汉栏天鹅绒与闽音 tiem-po-xiong 定夺。

entries.zh: 毛青：深青色绒呢料（汉栏色彩）；西栏作暗红（深绯）天鹅绒，两栏色相不合
entries.en: dark crimson velvet (per the Spanish headword); the Chinese gloss 毛青 names a dark blue(-black) cloth or dye colour — the two columns disagree
entries.notes: 汉栏毛青（深青）与西栏 carmesí obscure（暗绯红）色相矛盾，物件（深色绒料）可定而颜色不定。

entries.en: self-opinionated, fond of his own views
stubborn-minded, set in one's own thoughts
entries.notes: 汉栏「强思」第二字与闽音 guio-ki 对应不明（音写与第12条 quiang 不一致），词义据「强」词族推断。

entries.zh: 强辩、狡辩不服；逞强争辩
entries.en: to argue obstinately or quibble; to stick stubbornly to one's argument
entries.notes: 西语头词讹损严重（por fiado 似为 porfiado「强辩不休者」），强辩义据汉栏与闽音 kiang-pien 定夺。

entries.zh: 呼之不应——人已走开（叫也不答理）
entries.en: stubborn — will not answer even when called; has already gone off
entries.notes: 汉栏「怃已去」疑有讹（疑为「既已去」类语），义据西语 aun que le llaman no responde 与闽音 kai-kai-khu 推断。

entries.en: term, fixed period; deadline for payment or fulfilment
entries.notes: 闽栏三音节 gui-an-gi 与单字「期」不合、或含短语成分，期限义据西语 termino/plazo 与汉栏「期」。

entries.zh: 定期、限定日期〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: fixed term, appointed date; gloss uncertain (damaged columns)
entries.notes: 闽栏官栏均带污损（T99），义据西语 plazo 与汉栏「定」推断，音证不足。
